brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
North Macedonia is putting youth at risk by scrapping the rollout of sex education. [1]
Relations with North Macedonia are deteriorating, according to Kyuchyuk. [2]
The opposition in North Macedonia is urging a deeper probe into Independence Day spending. [3]
There is a call for refugee protection and access to justice in North Macedonia. [4]
The Štip wind farm in North Macedonia has reached financial close. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR NORTH MACEDONIA
The aim is to share borders with countries that uphold our values, implying a potential shift in foreign relations. [2]

KEY RISKS
Scrapping sex education rollout puts youth at risk in North Macedonia. [1]

WATCH ITEMS
The opposition urges a deeper probe into Independence Day spending, indicating unresolved scrutiny. [3]
The call for refugee protection and access to justice remains an ongoing concern. [4]
